Query constants (ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY) as pub const &str
extract_inheritance handler walks node tree via child_by_field_name and named_child iteration

constraints: DEFUSE_QUERY is mandatory - LanguageInfo.defuse_query field is Option<&'static str> and every language sets it
No feature flags - all languages unconditionally compiled in per lang.rs comment

test_coverage: Existing language tests verify ELEMENT_QUERY compilation, extract_inheritance correctness, and defuse_query write/read site extraction via SemanticExtractor

approaches.name: Direct Java Pattern
approaches.description: Create swift.rs with identical structure to java.rs: ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY constants and extract_inheritance handler

approaches.name: Minimal Query Set
approaches.description: Only implement ELEMENT_QUERY and DEFUSE_QUERY, skip optional queries (CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY)
cons: Requires future PRs for missing queries

recommendation: Direct Java Pattern - follows established conventions, provides complete feature set from day one, and matches the issue's explicit guidance to model after java.rs

    pub element_query: &'static str,

    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-swift grammar.ts: Walk class_declaration's _inheritance_specifiers child; for each inheritance_specifier node, read inherits_from field which contains user_type; extract type_identifier text from user_type. Multiple specifiers appear as siblings (superclass + protocols).
